text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Finishing touches put to action plan to apply programme outlined by President Liamine Zeroual. "Priority of priorities" for Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia remains the maximum dynamisation of the process of national reconstruction, rigour in political spending and speed in handling different dossiers.
- Growing international isolation of "terrorism" speeding up the dismantling of armed groups.

- Armed Islamic Group seems to be going through its last death throes, witnessed by a settling of scores for more than a year, increasing number of dissidents and a multitude of defections in the ranks of the criminals.
